title: AI Governance Standards for Networks: NIST and ISO
concept: NIST AI Risk Management Framework and ISO/IEC 42001 are the two leading horizontal AI governance standards. NIST AI RMF organizes risk work into four functions: Govern, Map, Measure and Manage. ISO 42001 is the first certifiable management system standard for AI. Both apply to autonomous network deployments and can be mapped into a unified IT, network and cybersecurity governance framework.
why: TM Forum is launching a Trustworthy AI Governance Certification for operators scaling autonomous networks. NIST AI RMF and ISO 42001 are both referenced in telecom autonomous-network governance work, and both integrate with COBIT and ISO 27001.
question: Which of the four NIST AI RMF functions do you expect to meet the most resistance when applied to network closed loops, and why?
